title: gentianella austriaca
intro: Gentianella austriaca, commonly known as Austrian spring gentian, is a perennial plant belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella austriaca include its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
